hotels.title: Coastal Puglia All-Suite Elegance with Daily Breakfast, Nightly Drinks & Spa Access
hotels.description: Tucked away in the sun-kissed seaside village paradise of Savelletri di Fasano, this Italian hideaway is your ticket to discovering the southern coastal magic of Puglia. This gem looks out upon the stunning Adriatic coastline, with views fit for a postcard. You'll be spoilt with a swimming pool straight out of a travel magazine, a rooftop terrace with panoramic views of the Mediterranean and surrounding region, plus a state-of-the-art spa grotto. The onsite restaurant offers everything from freshly caught fish to locally grown produce, with menus that are a true love letter to Italian cuisine. Bianco Riccio Suite Hotel's location hits the jackpot, placing you near charming villages full of ancient conical trulli houses and authentic local eats like panzerotti (fried pizza bites) or zeppole (cream-filled donuts with black cherry). Local boat tours reveal hidden caves, grottos and the immense coastline of this magical region.
